title: Advanced grammar
instructions: Complete each sentence with the correct form of the word(s) in brackets, or one missing word.

items.q: If I ______ (take) that job in Berlin, I would be living there now.
items.why: Mixed conditional: past condition (had + past participle) -> present result.

items.q: Not only ______ (he / forget) my birthday, but he also forgot our anniversary.
items.why: Negative adverbial at the start -> question-style inversion.

items.q: It's high time you ______ (start) looking for a new flat.
items.why: It's (high) time + subject + past simple (unreal past).

items.q: She ______ (be) at home - the lights are off and her car isn't there.
What I really need ______ a good night's sleep.
______ (finish) his speech, he sat down to loud applause.
items.why: Perfect participle for an action completed before the main one.

items.q: The suspect is believed ______ (leave) the country last week.
items.why: Passive reporting verb + perfect infinitive for a past action.

items.q: I'd rather you ______ (not / mention) this to anyone.
items.why: I'd rather + different subject + past simple.

items.q: ______ you need any help, don't hesitate to call.
items.why: Inverted first conditional: Should you need... = If you need...

items.q: We ______ (hurry). The train was late anyway, so we rushed for nothing.
items.why: needn't have + past participle: we did it, but it was unnecessary.

title: Collocations
instructions: Choose the word that forms the most natural collocation. Type the letter or the word.

items.q: She ___ a lot of effort into the project.

title: Phrasal verbs and idioms
instructions: Write ONE word in each gap.

items.q: The wedding was ______ off at the last minute.
I can't put ______ with his arrogance any longer.
We need to come up ______ a better plan.
Let's get the ball ______ and start the meeting.
That new laptop cost an arm and a ______.
She turned ______ the job offer because the salary was too low.
He's always sitting on the ______; he never takes sides.
I'll look ______ the matter and get back to you.
Don't worry, it's not rocket ______ - anyone can do it.
The two managers aren't on the same ______ about the budget.

title: Word formation
instructions: Use the word in CAPITALS to form a word that fits the gap.

items.q: The ______ of the new museum was delayed by six months. (OPEN)
Her ______ was obvious from the way she smiled. (HAPPY)
The results were rather ______, to be honest. (DISAPPOINT)
It's ______ to park on this side of the street. (LEGAL)
His sudden ______ surprised everyone in the department. (RESIGN)
We need a more environmentally ______ approach. (SUSTAIN)
We seriously ______ the time the project would take. (ESTIMATE)
These two drugs should never be taken ______. (SIMULTANEOUS)
She has been a lifelong ______ of human rights. (DEFEND)
The speech was ______ long; most people stopped listening. (NECESSARY)
